newsitem.title: USA: White Rose Foods increases offer for notes.
newsitem.headline: White Rose Foods increases offer for notes.

text.p: White Rose Foods Inc and its Di Giorgio Corp subsidiary said on Monday they have increased the tender offer price for two series of notes.
The total offering price for the White Rose senior discount notes due 1998 has been increased $911.80 per $1,000 face principal amount, the companies said.
The total offering price for the Di Giorgio 12 percent senior notes due 2003 has been increased to $1,077.50 per $1,000 principal amount, the companies said.
The tender offers will expire at 1700 EDT, on June 20, 1997, unless extended.

To receive a consent payment, holders must tender their Notes and provide their consents to the proposed amendments at any time on or prior to 1700 EDT on June 9 or after the majority of principal of the notes give consents, the companies said.
Merrill Lynch & Co and BT Securities Corp are acting as dealer managers for the tender offers and consent solicitations.
